D014472.s: The pit in the center of the abdominal wall marking the point where the umbilical cord entered in the fetus.

D019237.s: The constricted part of the tooth at the junction of the crown and root or roots. (Jablonski, Dictionary of Dentistry, 1992, p530, p433)
